title: Custom Vulkan cache witness requires manual VULKAN_SDK provisioning
body: With VIXEN_AUTO_PROVISION_VULKAN=OFF and a disposable VIXEN_VULKAN_CACHE_DIR, configure failed at ProvisionVulkan.cmake:307 because the custom cache does not contain the SDK and the shared VULKAN_SDK was not inherited. Workaround: explicitly export VULKAN_SDK=/home/liory/.cache/vixen/vulkan-sdk/1.4.350.1/x86_64 for configure and target regeneration. Suggested consolidation: make custom-cache validation resolve the shared SDK declaratively or reject the incompatible override before configure.
